Tournament File Interoperability
Starting List transfers players only. Editable Tournament transfers tournament setup + players but intentionally exports 0 round-history slots, giving the receiving tournament program the best chance to keep setup/pairing options editable; existing Chess-Publisher rounds/results are not included in that TXT and are not changed in Chess-Publisher. Export Tournament in TXT transfers the complete generated history for continuation from the current round; the receiving tournament program can then lock fundamental setup fields because the tournament has already started. Native TUNx export remains hidden because the template-based workflow is experimental.
